title: Ulnar Collateral Ligament Injuries in Pediatric and Adolescent Throwing Athletes.

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: » There has been an alarming increase in the incidence of ulnar collateral ligament (UCL) injuries among youth patients.» Preventative programs are effective in reducing the risk of UCL injuries in youth patients.» Further research on UCL injury in this particular population would be beneficial given the increasing incidence of pathology and unique considerations apart from adult patients.
